  MEETING OF THE
  RECREATION COMMISSION
  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 13, 2023 AT 6:00 PM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the
Recreation Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Monday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
kshigenaga@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0791 at least 48 hours prior to
the meeting.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the Recreation Commission may teleconference into the meeting without noticing
each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID­19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that
members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s
current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged
provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to kshigenaga@CityofSanMarino.org until
  3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the Commission Chair or Secretary
  during public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Tsai, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chair Solan, and Chair Yen

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Recreation
Commission on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the
Recreation Commission. Pursuant to state law, the Recreation Commission may not discuss or
take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The
Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

This is an opportunity for members of the Recreation Commission to inform the public and

Commissioners may provide feedback related to program and service offerings.

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the Recreation Commission. All public writings distributed by the City
of San Marino to at least a majority of the Recreation Commission regarding any item on this
agenda will be made available at the Stoneman Building located at 1560 Pasqualito Drive,
San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the Recreation Commission meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO RECREATION COMMISSION
  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 13, 2023 AT 6:00 P.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Vice Chairperson Solan called the regular meeting to order at 6:01 p.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Vice Chairperson Solan led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Commissioner Tsai, Commissioner Wu, and Vice Chairperson
  Solan

  ABSENT: Commissioner Tam and Chairperson Yen

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

Commissioner Wu shared that he attended the Lunar New Year event at Lacy Park. He shared that
the event appeared to be well run and all in attendance appeared happy about the event.

Commissioner Tsai shared that the Lacy Park Playground Committee met once and discussed the
one bid received to re-do the playground. She explained that the next step is to go back to Council
to request additional funds, since the original budget amount is only enough to cover the planning.

NEW BUSINESS

1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Commissioner Tsai moved, seconded by Commissioner Wu, to approve the minutes from January
9, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tsai, Commissioner Wu, and Vice Chairperson Solan
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tam and Chairperson Yen
 RECREATION COMMISSION MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 13, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

2. DIRECTOR AND RECREATION MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Recreation Manager Covarrubias presented the staff report. Commissioner
Tsai encouraged staff to consider furthering the intergenerational aspect of the Valentine’s Day
Grams activity by hosting an event where youth get paired with a local senior citizen.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

3. DISCUSSION OF FY 2023-24 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN PROJECTS FOR
  THE RECREATION DIVISION

Director Johnson and Recreation Manager Covarrubias presented the staff report. Commissioner
Wu inquired if the selected vehicles meet AQMD requirements. Recreation Manager Covarrubias
responded that staff have been working with Finance to ensure that vehicles meet the requirements
to receive AQMD funding.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - Hal Suetsugu

Commissioner Wu moved, seconded by Commissioner Tsai, to support staff’s recommendations of
the two CIP projects for FY 2023-24.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tsai, Commissioner Wu, and Vice Chairperson Solan
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tam and Chairperson Yen

4. CONSIDER NAME CHANGE FROM SAN MARINO CENTER TO SAN MARINO
  COMMUNITY CENTER

Director Johnson presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Commissioner Tsai moved, seconded by Commissioner Wu, to request that the City Council
approve of the name change from San Marino Center to San Marino Community Center.
 RECREATION COMMISSION MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 13, 2023  PAGE 3 OF 3

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tsai, Commissioner Wu, and Vice Chairperson Solan
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tam and Chairperson Yen

5. FY 2023-24 PRIORITY INITIATIVE - REBUID A SESNSE OF COMMUNITY

Director Johnson presented the staff report. Commissioner Tsai recommended that staff consider
ping pong events, given the community's population, or other adult only programs. Director Johnson
responded that staff have that on their radar, but need to consider storage space when planning
programs. Recreation Manager Covarrubias responded that successful programs have been the
Parent and Me, but staff are considering other programs for just adults. Director Johnson added that
staff are aware that they need to expand their instructor pool.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  None

ADIOURNMENT

Vice Chairperson Solan adjourned the meeting at 6:56 p.m.
